# Taprico — Complete LLM & Agent Reference

> Taprico (`https://taprico.com`) is a fast, static, local-first workbench of 12 free developer utilities and US freelance finance calculators that execute 100% client-side inside the user's browser—with zero logins, zero backend payload uploads, and watermark-free US Letter vector PDF exports.

## Core Architecture & Privacy Guarantees

- **100% Client-Side Execution:** Built with Astro static site generation (`astro build`) and isolated React islands. All tool computations happen strictly in browser memory.
- **Zero Data Transmission:** JSON/YAML payloads, JWT tokens, HMAC signing secrets, SQL queries, regex inputs, diff texts, and client invoice details never leave the user's device.
- **Cryptography:** JWT HS256/HS384/HS512 verification uses the native browser Web Crypto API (`crypto.subtle`).
- **PDF Generation:** Vector US Letter (`8.5" × 11"`) PDFs are synthesized locally using `jspdf` without watermarks or server-side rendering; optional company branding persists strictly in browser `localStorage`.
- **Keyboard Navigation:** Global `Cmd+K` / `Ctrl+K` command palette searches across all 12 tools, templates, and guides.
- **Contact & Repository:** `hello@taprico.com` · `https://github.com/GIT-HUB-VAIBHAV/taprico` (MIT License)

---

## 1. Developer Studio Tools (8)

- **JSON & YAML Formatter, Validator & Converter** — `https://taprico.com/tools/json-yaml-formatter/`
  - Modes: Format JSON, Minify JSON, JSON → YAML, YAML → JSON, interactive Tree Inspector (dot/bracket path copy), alphabetical key sorting, 2/4-space or tab indent, line/column error diagnostics.
- **JWT Decoder, Claims Inspector & Signature Verifier** — `https://taprico.com/tools/jwt-decoder/`
  - Decodes Base64URL Header & Payload, translates `exp`/`iat`/`nbf` into US Eastern, Pacific, and UTC dates with live countdown, warns on `alg:none` or missing `exp`, and verifies HS256/HS384/HS512 locally via Web Crypto.
- **Cron Expression Generator, Explainer & Schedule Tester** — `https://taprico.com/tools/cron-expression-generator/`
  - Two-way 5-field cron builder (`minute hour day-of-month month day-of-week`), plain-English descriptions, and next-10 execution preview across `America/New_York`, `America/Chicago`, `America/Denver`, `America/Los_Angeles`, and `UTC`.
- **Regex Tester, Match Highlighter & Replace Debugger** — `https://taprico.com/tools/regex-tester/`
  - Live ECMAScript regex matching with `g`, `i`, `m`, `s`, `u` flags, color-coded match/capture group table, and find-and-replace output preview.
- **Base64 Encoder, Decoder & File Data-URI Studio** — `https://taprico.com/tools/base64-encoder-decoder/`
  - UTF-8 safe Base64 and Base64URL encoding/decoding plus local file-to-Data-URI conversion.
- **UUID Generator (v4, v7), ULID & Timestamp Inspector** — `https://taprico.com/tools/uuid-generator/`
  - Generates RFC 9562 time-ordered UUID v7, random UUID v4, and ULID batches; inspects embedded millisecond timestamps from UUID v7; exports SQL `INSERT` batches.
- **SQL Formatter, Beautifier & Multi-Dialect Minifier** — `https://taprico.com/tools/sql-formatter/`
  - Formats or minifies PostgreSQL, MySQL, SQLite, T-SQL, BigQuery, and standard ANSI SQL queries offline.
- **Code & Text Diff Checker** — `https://taprico.com/tools/diff-checker/`
  - Side-by-side and unified diff comparison with line- and character-level change highlights.

---

## 2. US Freelance & Business Calculators (4)

- **US Freelance & Small Business PDF Invoice Generator** — `https://taprico.com/tools/invoice-generator/`
  - Exports crisp US Letter vector PDFs with zero watermarks, custom logo PNG/JPEG upload, Net 7/15/30/60 terms, percentage/flat discounts, state sales tax, and saved `localStorage` company profile.
- **Hourly to Salary Converter** — `https://taprico.com/tools/hourly-to-salary-converter/`
  - Standard 2,080-hour baseline adjusted for unpaid PTO weeks and unpaid US holidays, comparing W-2 pay vs. 1099 contractor equivalent (factoring in 15.3% FICA self-employment tax and benefits overhead).
- **US Freelance Rate & 1099 Pricing Calculator** — `https://taprico.com/tools/freelance-rate-calculator/`
  - Works backward from target take-home income, billable utilization rate (accounting for admin/sales hours), 15.3% self-employment tax, health insurance, retirement, and business overhead to output required hourly, daily, and weekly rates.
- **Profit Margin, Markup & Break-Even ROAS Calculator** — `https://taprico.com/tools/profit-margin-markup-calculator/`
  - Uses exact accounting formulas: `Gross Margin (%) = ((Price - Cost) / Price) × 100`, `Markup (%) = ((Price - Cost) / Cost) × 100`, and `Break-Even ROAS = 1 / Gross Margin Ratio`.
